title: EviRover: Reinforcing Agentic Perception Beyond a Glance
title_zh: EviRover：强化超越一瞥的智能体感知

paragraphs.en: Visual perception is conventionally formulated as a one-shot prediction from a single glance at the image, under the assumption that the image content and the model’s parametric knowledge suffice to resolve the query. This assumption often fails in real-world scenarios that hinge on fine-grained visual details or require knowledge-intensive and up-to-date information. We term such cases perception under insufficient evidence and formulate perception as an agentic process that can obtain information beyond a single glance. To address the absence of data for this setting, we design two dedicated data generation pipelines, yielding EviRover-SFT-5K and EviRover-RL-12K for training. We further construct EviLens, a human-verified benchmark comprising 688 instances across five perception categories. Building on these data, we present EviRover, to our knowledge the first perception agent explicitly trained to resolve perceptual queries through interaction, using supervised fine-tuning followed by agentic reinforcement learning. Experiments show that the 4B EviRover outperforms its backbone by 30 points on average on EviLens, reaching performance comparable to advanced proprietary models. The gains transfer beyond EviLens to WebEyes, conventional perception benchmarks, and general multimodal benchmarks, including a 15-point improvement on BrowseComp-VL. All code, models, and data are released.

paragraphs.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have progressed rapidly in reasoning and tool use ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2026 ; Du et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026 ) . These advances have enabled multimodal agents to address increasingly complex visual questions through multi-step interaction ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Fan et al., 2026 ; Chu et al., 2026 ; Jiao et al., 2026 ) . Yet in most such systems, agentic interaction serves question answering rather than perceptual prediction. Perception tasks themselves have largely retained their conventional formulation ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Tang et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Deng et al., 2026 ; Pacini et al., 2026 ) . Grounding, segmentation, and counting are still commonly treated as one-shot predictions from an image-query pair, based on a single glance at the input image. This formulation assumes that the image and the model’s parametric knowledge are sufficient to resolve the query. In practice, fine-grained visual details may require closer inspection, while identifying the target may depend on knowledge beyond the image. We refer to such cases as perception under insufficient evidence . In these settings, a single glance is insufficient to determine the required perceptual output, yet the model must still produce a location, a boundary, or a count without the opportunity for further search.

paragraphs.en: We therefore reformulate perception under insufficient evidence as an evidence-seeking process. Rather than predicting directly from the initial observation, the model can search through finer-grained visual inspection or external knowledge sources to resolve the perceptual task. Whereas existing multimodal agents ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) gather evidence to support a textual answer, the proposed formulation treats the perceptual output itself as the objective. This makes perception a stricter test of evidence seeking: in question answering, searched evidence can be converted directly into a textual answer, whereas in perception it must be translated into a location, a boundary, or a count on the input image, which demands fine-grained visual understanding. Moreover, the perceptual output is directly verifiable against spatial or numerical annotations, and is correct only if the agent both acquires the missing evidence and correctly relates it to the visual content. Perception is also of considerable practical value, as accurate perception underpins downstream applications such as embodied manipulation ( Zhang et al., 2024a ; Kim et al., 2026 ) and image editing ( Liu et al., 2024a ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . Despite these advantages, agentic perception poses a central challenge: the missing evidence varies across queries. A small target calls for closer inspection, whereas an unfamiliar identity calls for external search. Deciding what to acquire and how is therefore part of the task rather than a fixed procedure. Recent prompt-based workflows ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2026a ) have begun to incorporate web search into perception. However, they rely on manually designed prompting strategies at inference time, so their searching behavior is bounded by human-designed heuristics rather than learned from task feedback. Liang et al. (2026) train an agent that interleaves reasoning with web search. But it is limited to segmentation and assumes that missing evidence is always external knowledge.

paragraphs.en: Inspired by recent developments in agentic reinforcement learning for visual question answering ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Hong et al., 2026 ) , we ask: can we train agents to learn when and how to search to push perception beyond a single glance?
paragraphs.zh: 受智能体强化学习在视觉问答领域近期发展的启发（Zheng 等，2026；Wu 等，2026；Hong 等，2026），我们提出一个问题：我们能否训练智能体学会何时以及如何进行搜索，从而使其感知能力超越单次观察的局限？

paragraphs.en: To answer this question, we introduce EviRover, to our knowledge the first agent trained to search both within and beyond the image to resolve perceptual queries. EviRover moves beyond a single glance : at each step, it decides whether further evidence is needed and which action can provide it, before producing a location, a boundary, or a count. As existing perception datasets do not cover this setting, we design two data generation pipelines, each targeting one form of evidence insufficiency. For evidence present in the image but not discernible at a glance, we collect high-resolution images with targets occupying less than 0.1% of the image area, together with scenes requiring multi-step visual exploration, such as I-spy and spot-the-difference puzzles. For evidence beyond the image, we construct queries over group photographs of public figures and anime characters through two procedures: (1) starting from group photographs and verifying the identities of the depicted individuals; and (2) starting from a reference image of a known individual or character and synthesizing a group photograph containing them with GPT-Image-2 ( OpenAI, 2026b ) , followed by filtering with Seed-2.0-Pro ( Seed, 2026b ) for visual quality and identity preservation. These pipelines yield two training sets, EviRover-SFT-5K and EviRover-RL-12K, and EviLens, a human-verified benchmark of 688 instances spanning segmentation, counting, and three grounding categories: localization, recognition, and spot-the-difference. Figure 1 presents representative examples.
paragraphs.zh: 为回答这个问题，我们引入了 EviRover——据我们所知，这是首个接受训练以在图像内部和外部同时搜索、从而解决感知性查询的智能体。 EviRover 不再局限于单次观察：在每个步骤中，它都会先判断是否需要更多证据以及何种行动能提供这些证据，然后再输出位置、边界或数量。 由于现有的感知数据集并未涵盖这一场景，我们设计了两种数据生成流程，每种流程都针对一种证据不足的形式。 针对图像中存在但无法一眼识别的证据，我们收集了高分辨率图像，其中目标区域占图像面积的比例低于 0.1%，同时还包括需要多步骤视觉探索的场景，例如“I-spy”和“找不同”谜题。 针对图像之外的证据，我们通过两种方法构建了对公众人物和动漫角色群像的查询：（1）从群像照片出发，验证其中所描绘人物的身份；以及（2）从已知人物或角色的参考图像出发，使用 GPT-Image-2（OpenAI, 2026b）合成包含他们的群像照片，随后使用 Seed-2.0-Pro（Seed, 2026b）进行过滤，以确保视觉质量和身份保留。 这些流程生成了两个训练集：EviRover-SFT-5K 和 EviRover-RL-12K，以及 EviLens——一个经过人类验证的基准数据集，包含 688 个实例，涵盖分割、计数以及三种定位类别：定位、识别和“找不同”。 图 1 展示了代表性示例。

sents.zh: 针对图像之外的证据，我们通过两种方法构建了对公众人物和动漫角色群像的查询：（1）从群像照片出发，验证其中所描绘人物的身份；以及（2）从已知人物或角色的参考图像出发，使用 GPT-Image-2（OpenAI, 2026b）合成包含他们的群像照片，随后使用 Seed-2.0-Pro（Seed, 2026b）进行过滤，以确保视觉质量和身份保留。

sents.en: These pipelines yield two training sets, EviRover-SFT-5K and EviRover-RL-12K, and EviLens, a human-verified benchmark of 688 instances spanning segmentation, counting, and three grounding categories: localization, recognition, and spot-the-difference.
sents.zh: 这些流程生成了两个训练集：EviRover-SFT-5K 和 EviRover-RL-12K，以及 EviLens——一个经过人类验证的基准数据集，包含 688 个实例，涵盖分割、计数以及三种定位类别：定位、识别和“找不同”。

paragraphs.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of EviRover. On EviLens, EviRover improves over its Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct backbone by 30 points on average across the five categories, bringing a 4B model to a level comparable with advanced proprietary models such as Seed-2.1-turbo and Gemini-3.5-Flash. We also evaluate on WebEyes ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , a benchmark for search-based grounding, segmentation, and visual question answering, where EviRover improves over its backbone by 14.4 IoU on grounding and 24.7 gIoU on segmentation. The gains further extend beyond our setting: EviRover consistently improves on conventional perception benchmarks such as ReasonSeg ( Lai et al., 2024 ) and RefCOCOg ( Mao et al., 2016 ; Nagaraja et al., 2016 ) , as well as general multimodal benchmarks, including MMMU ( Yue et al., 2024 ) , MMMU-Pro ( Yue et al., 2025 ) , and MathVerse ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) , with a 15-point gain on BrowseComp-VL ( Geng et al., 2026 ) . These results indicate that learning to search under insufficient evidence not only enhances perception but also yields capabilities that generalize well beyond the training distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 广泛的实验证明了 EviRover 的有效性。 在 EviLens 上，EviRover 相较于其 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct 基础模型，在五个类别中的平均得分提升了 30 分，使一个 4B 模型达到了与 Seed-2.1-turbo 和 Gemini-3.5-Flash 等先进的专有模型相媲美的水平。 我们还在 WebEyes（Yang 等人，2026）上进行了评估，该基准用于基于搜索的 grounding、分割和视觉问答任务。在此基准中，EviRover 相较于其基础模型在 grounding 上的 IoU 提升了 14.4，在分割上的 gIoU 提升了 24.7。 这些提升还进一步超越了我们的实验设置：EviRover 在常规感知基准（如 ReasonSeg（Lai 等人，2024）和 RefCOCOg（Mao 等人，2016；Nagaraja 等人，2016））以及通用多模态基准（包括 MMMU（Yue 等人，2024）、MMMU-Pro（Yue 等人，2025）和 MathVerse（Zhang 等人，2024b））上均表现稳定提升，在 BrowseComp-VL（Geng 等人，2026）上的得分提升了 15 分。 这些结果表明，在证据不足的情况下学习搜索不仅增强了感知能力，还产生了能够泛化到远超训练分布之外的能力。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献可概括如下：

paragraphs.en: We identify perception under insufficient evidence and reformulate perception as an evidence-seeking process that looks beyond a single glance .
paragraphs.zh: 我们识别出在证据不足情况下的感知，并将感知重新定义为一种超越单次观察的证据寻求过程。

paragraphs.en: We present EviRover , to our knowledge the first perception agent trained to determine what evidence is missing and how to acquire it.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 EviRover——据我们所知，这是首个经过训练、能够判断哪些证据缺失以及如何获取这些证据的感知智能体。

paragraphs.en: To address the absence of data for perception under insufficient evidence, we design two dedicated data generation pipelines, yielding EviRover-SFT-5K , EviRover-RL-12K , and EviLens , a human-verified benchmark of 688 instances.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决在证据不足情况下感知数据缺失的问题，我们设计了两个专门的数据生成流程，从而得到了 EviRover-SFT-5K、EviRover-RL-12K 以及由人类验证的包含 688 个实例的基准数据集 EviLens。

paragraphs.en: Extensive experiments validate EviRover: it improves over its backbone by 30 points on average on EviLens and generalizes to WebEyes, conventional perception benchmarks, and general multimodal benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 大量实验验证了 EviRover 的有效性：在 EviLens 数据集上，其性能相比基础模型平均提升了 30 分，并且能够泛化到 WebEyes、传统感知基准以及通用多模态基准。

paragraphs.en: Grounding ( Kamath et al., 2021 ) , segmentation ( Hu et al., 2016 ) , and counting ( Amini-Naieni et al., 2023 ) are conventionally formulated as predicting a location, a boundary, or a count from an image and a query. Beyond specialized detectors ( Liu et al., 2024b ) , segmentation models ( Carion et al., 2025 ) , and counting models ( Amini-Naieni et al., 2024 ) , MLLM-based methods extend these tasks to free-form queries requiring reasoning ( Lai et al., 2024 ; You & Wu, 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) . In parallel, a growing body of work has focused specifically on fine-grained perception of small objects in high-resolution images ( Goto et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Jia et al., 2026 ) . However, these advances retain the one-shot formulation, in which the evidence needed to resolve the query is assumed to be present in the input image. Our work lifts this assumption, allowing the perceptual prediction to draw on evidence acquired beyond a single glance at the image.
paragraphs.zh: 定位（Kamath 等人，2021）、分割（Hu 等人，2016）和计数（Amini-Naieni 等人，2023）通常被表述为从图像和查询中预测位置、边界或数量。 除了专门的检测器（Liu 等人，2024b）、分割模型（Carion 等人，2025）和计数模型（Amini-Naieni 等人，2024）之外，基于 MLLM 的方法将这些任务扩展到需要推理的自由形式查询（Lai 等人，2024；You & Wu，2025；Liu 等人，2025）。 与此同时，越来越多的研究专门关注高分辨率图像中小物体的精细感知（Goto 等人，2025；Zhang 等人，2026；Jia 等人，2026）。 然而，这些进展仍然保留了一次性样本的表述方式，即解决查询所需的证据被认为存在于输入图像中。 我们的工作打破了这一假设，使得感知预测可以利用单次观察图像之外获取的证据。

paragraphs.en: A broad class of visual questions cannot be resolved from the image and the model’s parametric knowledge alone ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ; Choi et al., 2026 ) . One line of work, often referred to as thinking with images ( Su et al., 2025 ) , enables models to actively inspect image regions through operations such as zooming and cropping ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Wu & Xie, 2024 ; Guo et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Another line develops multimodal search agents that acquire external knowledge through web search, progressing from short-horizon search to long-horizon deep research ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Geng et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ) . However, these works acquire evidence to produce textual answers, treating perception as a means rather than an end. Recent attempts extend search to segmentation and grounding ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2026a ; Liang et al., 2026 ) , but either rely on manually designed prompting or restrict evidence seeking to external search for a specific task. In contrast, our work treats perception as the goal of evidence seeking, where the acquired evidence must be resolved into a perceptual prediction on the input image. Since the kind of evidence a query lacks varies, deciding what to acquire and how becomes an integral part of the task.

paragraphs.en: We construct perception queries over group photographs of people, including public figures and anime characters, through two complementary procedures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过两种互补的流程，针对包含公众人物和动漫角色的群体照片构建感知查询。

paragraphs.en: The first collects real group photographs and verifies the identities of the people they depict. We begin from a manually written seed list of 85 event categories spanning award ceremonies, music groups, esports competitions, political summits, product launches, academic events, sports competitions, and entertainment programs. We prompt Seed-1.8 to expand each category into concrete search queries, which are then issued to an image search engine to obtain group photographs and their associated captions. However, captions are an unreliable source of identity annotations, as they are absent for most collected images and frequently incomplete or inaccurate when present. We therefore verify identities independently using Seed-2.0-Pro equipped with web search tools.
paragraphs.zh: 第一步是收集真实的团体照片，并验证照片中人物的身份。 我们从一份手动编写的 85 个事件类别的种子列表开始，涵盖颁奖典礼、音乐团体、电子竞技比赛、政治峰会、产品发布、学术活动、体育竞赛和娱乐节目。 我们提示 Seed-1.8 将每个类别扩展为具体的搜索查询，然后向图像搜索引擎发起这些查询，以获取团体照片及其相关的说明文字。 然而，说明文字并非可靠的身份标注来源，因为大多数收集到的图像都没有说明文字，而即使存在，也常常不完整或不准确。 因此，我们使用配备网络搜索工具的 Seed-2.0-Pro 独立验证人物身份。

paragraphs.en: The second procedure starts from a reference image of a known individual or character and synthesizes a group photograph containing that individual. Since single-person images with verifiable identities are far more abundant than group photographs in which every identity can be verified, this procedure covers a substantially broader range of identities. We initially explored conditioning generation on multiple verified reference images simultaneously. For real individuals, identity preservation degrades sharply as the number of references increases, remaining reliable for only up to approximately three references. Beyond this number, the generated individuals can no longer be reliably matched to their references through reverse image search, a failure further confirmed by manual inspection. Anime characters, in contrast, are defined by distinctive visual traits such as hairstyles and costumes, and remain well preserved under multi-reference conditioning. We therefore condition each generation of real individuals on a single reference identity while leaving the other individuals in the scene unconstrained, and condition anime generation on multiple character references. The images are synthesized with GPT-Image-2 and filtered by Seed-2.0-Pro, which assesses visual quality and verifies identity preservation by searching for the generated individual and confirming that the results match the reference identity.
paragraphs.zh: 第二种方法从一个已知个体或角色的参考图像开始，合成包含该个体的集体照片。 由于具有可验证身份的单张人物图像远比每份身份都可被核实的集体照片更为丰富，因此这种方法覆盖了范围大得多的身份。 我们最初尝试将生成过程同时基于多张经过验证的参考图像进行条件约束。 对于真实个体而言，随着参考图像数量的增加，身份保留效果会急剧下降，在最多约三张参考图像时仍能保持可靠。 超过这个数量后，生成的个体已无法通过反向图像搜索与参考图像可靠匹配，手动检查也进一步证实了这一失败。 相比之下，动漫角色由发型和服装等独特的视觉特征所定义，在多参考图像的条件约束下仍能很好地保留这些特征。 因此，我们在生成真实个体时，仅以单个参考身份作为条件约束，而对场景中的其他个体不作限制；在生成动漫角色时，则以多个角色参考图像作为条件。 这些图像由 GPT-Image-2 合成，并通过 Seed-2.0-Pro 进行筛选；该工具会评估视觉质量，并通过搜索生成的个体来验证身份是否被保留，同时确认结果与参考身份一致。

sents.en: The second procedure starts from a reference image of a known individual or character and synthesizes a group photograph containing that individual.
sents.zh: 第二种方法从一个已知个体或角色的参考图像开始，合成包含该个体的集体照片。

sents.en: Since single-person images with verifiable identities are far more abundant than group photographs in which every identity can be verified, this procedure covers a substantially broader range of identities.
sents.zh: 由于具有可验证身份的单张人物图像远比每份身份都可被核实的集体照片更为丰富，因此这种方法覆盖了范围大得多的身份。

sents.en: We initially explored conditioning generation on multiple verified reference images simultaneously.
sents.zh: 我们最初尝试将生成过程同时基于多张经过验证的参考图像进行条件约束。

sents.en: For real individuals, identity preservation degrades sharply as the number of references increases, remaining reliable for only up to approximately three references.
sents.zh: 对于真实个体而言，随着参考图像数量的增加，身份保留效果会急剧下降，在最多约三张参考图像时仍能保持可靠。

sents.en: Beyond this number, the generated individuals can no longer be reliably matched to their references through reverse image search, a failure further confirmed by manual inspection.
sents.zh: 超过这个数量后，生成的个体已无法通过反向图像搜索与参考图像可靠匹配，手动检查也进一步证实了这一失败。

sents.en: Anime characters, in contrast, are defined by distinctive visual traits such as hairstyles and costumes, and remain well preserved under multi-reference conditioning.
sents.zh: 相比之下，动漫角色由发型和服装等独特的视觉特征所定义，在多参考图像的条件约束下仍能很好地保留这些特征。

sents.en: We therefore condition each generation of real individuals on a single reference identity while leaving the other individuals in the scene unconstrained, and condition anime generation on multiple character references.
sents.zh: 因此，我们在生成真实个体时，仅以单个参考身份作为条件约束，而对场景中的其他个体不作限制；在生成动漫角色时，则以多个角色参考图像作为条件。

sents.en: The images are synthesized with GPT-Image-2 and filtered by Seed-2.0-Pro, which assesses visual quality and verifies identity preservation by searching for the generated individual and confirming that the results match the reference identity.
sents.zh: 这些图像由 GPT-Image-2 合成，并通过 Seed-2.0-Pro 进行筛选；该工具会评估视觉质量，并通过搜索生成的个体来验证身份是否被保留，同时确认结果与参考身份一致。

paragraphs.en: The two procedures thus yield group photographs with different levels of identity coverage: real photographs may have some or all depicted individuals verified, synthesized photographs of real individuals contain exactly one verified individual, and synthesized anime images may contain multiple verified characters.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，这两种方法生成的群体照片在身份覆盖程度方面有所不同：真实照片中，所描绘的个人可能有部分或全部经过验证；由真实个人合成的照片则恰好包含一个经过验证的个人；而合成的动漫图像可能包含多个经过验证的角色。

paragraphs.en: The verified identities serve as ground truth for query construction. Grounding and segmentation queries require at least one verified identity per image, which serves as the target to be localized or segmented. Counting queries require every depicted individual to be verified, and are formulated over attributes shared among them, such as affiliation with a particular institution or receipt of a particular honor.
paragraphs.zh: 经过验证的身份信息为查询构建提供了基准事实。 定位和分割查询每张图像至少需要一个经过验证的身份信息，该身份信息将作为需要定位或分割的目标。 计数查询要求对画面中出现的每一个个体进行验证，并基于他们共有的属性来构建查询，例如是否隶属于某个特定机构或是否获得过某项特定荣誉。

sents.zh: 定位和分割查询每张图像至少需要一个经过验证的身份信息，该身份信息将作为需要定位或分割的目标。

sents.en: Counting queries require every depicted individual to be verified, and are formulated over attributes shared among them, such as affiliation with a particular institution or receipt of a particular honor.
sents.zh: 计数查询要求对画面中出现的每一个个体进行验证，并基于他们共有的属性来构建查询，例如是否隶属于某个特定机构或是否获得过某项特定荣誉。

paragraphs.en: In their initial form, these queries name the target directly, for example by asking for the mask of a specific individual. A model that recognizes the named individual can resolve such queries without seeking any additional evidence. To make evidence seeking necessary, we rewrite each query into a multi-hop form through iterative entity replacement. At each step, we select an entity in the current query, obtain its public profile through a search engine, and prompt GPT-5.4-mini to replace the entity with an indirect description that identifies it without naming it. The replacement terminates once Seed-1.8 can no longer resolve the query without tools, with a maximum of 20 hops.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些查询的初始形式中，目标会被直接提及，例如通过询问某个特定个体的面具。 能够识别所提及个体的模型可以在不寻求任何额外证据的情况下解决此类查询。 为了使证据搜寻成为必要，我们通过迭代替换实体将每个查询改写为多跳形式。 在每一步中，我们选择当前查询中的一个实体，通过搜索引擎获取其公开资料，并提示 GPT-5.4-mini 用无需提及名称但能识别该实体的间接描述来替换它。 当 Seed-1.8 无法再在没有工具的情况下解决该查询时，替换过程即终止，最多允许 20 次跳转。

paragraphs.en: We generate agent trajectories for the constructed queries, using Gemini-3.0-Pro for localization queries and Seed-2.0-Pro for the remaining tasks, and retain only those that reach the correct answer through a logically consistent sequence of actions. Correctness alone, however, does not ensure that a trajectory exhibits the intended behavior. For example, queries about widely recognized individuals are often resolved by a single search or directly from parametric knowledge, involving little evidence seeking. We therefore downsample such trajectories while retaining a portion of them, so that the model learns both to answer directly when its knowledge suffices and to seek evidence when it does not. Figure 4 shows the resulting composition of EviRover-SFT-5K.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为构建的查询生成智能体轨迹，其中本地化查询使用 Gemini-3.0-Pro，其余任务使用 Seed-2.0-Pro，并仅保留那些通过逻辑一致的动作序列得出正确答案的轨迹。 然而，仅凭正确性并不能确保一条轨迹表现出预期的行为。 例如，关于广为人知的个人的查询通常可以通过一次搜索或直接从参数化知识中解决，几乎不涉及证据搜寻。 因此，我们对这类轨迹进行下采样，同时保留其中一部分，以便模型既能学会在知识充分时直接作答，也能在知识不足时主动搜寻证据。 图 4 展示了由此形成的 EviRover-SFT-5K 的组成结构。

paragraphs.en: Together, these procedures yield two training sets, EviRover-SFT-5K and EviRover-RL-12K.
paragraphs.zh: 这些流程共同生成了两个训练集：EviRover-SFT-5K 和 EviRover-RL-12K。

paragraphs.en: We construct EviLens with the pipelines above and manually verify every instance, yielding a benchmark of 688 instances for evaluating perception under insufficient evidence. It covers segmentation, counting, and three grounding categories that differ in the type of missing evidence. Localization targets are explicitly named but tiny or hidden among clutter, as in high-resolution scenes and I-spy puzzles. Recognition targets are visually salient but referred to indirectly, requiring external information to identify. Spot-the-difference targets are defined relative to a second panel and require cross-panel comparison. Segmentation and counting share the recognition setting but output masks and counts, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用上述流程构建 EviLens，并手动验证每个实例，最终生成一个包含 688 个实例的基准数据集，用于评估在证据不足情况下的感知能力。 该基准涵盖分割、计数以及三种缺失证据类型各不相同的定位类别。 定位目标有明确名称，但尺寸极小或隐藏在杂乱背景中，例如高分辨率场景和“I-spy”谜题中的目标。 识别目标在视觉上十分突出，但需要通过间接方式提及，因此需要借助外部信息才能确定其身份。 “找不同”类目标需结合第二张面板进行定义，并需要跨面板比较才能完成识别。 分割和计数任务共享相同的识别设置，但分别输出掩码和计数结果。

paragraphs.en: Recognition and localization are evaluated by mean box IoU and R@0.5. Segmentation is evaluated by gIoU (mean per-instance IoU) and cIoU (cumulative intersection over cumulative union). Counting is evaluated by exact-match accuracy. paragraphs.en: We train EviRover in two stages. SFT establishes the interaction format and basic tool-use skills, while RL teaches the model to identify what evidence each query lacks and how to acquire it, using the correctness of the final perceptual output as feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 我们以两个阶段训练 EviRover。 SFT 确立了交互格式和基础工具使用技能，而 RL 则通过以最终感知输出的正确性作为反馈，教会模型识别每个查询缺少哪些证据以及如何获取这些证据。

paragraphs.en: EviRover operates with a set of ten tools, shared across trajectory labeling, training, and evaluation. Four tools acquire external evidence: text search, text-to-image search, image search, and web browsing. Three tools support fine-grained visual inspection, such as cropping a region for closer examination and rendering a candidate region on the original image for verification. The remaining three support task-specific prediction: SAM3-based mask generation, side-by-side region comparison for spot-the-difference queries, and a Python interpreter. Table 6 summarizes the available tools; detailed specifications and complete tool schemas are provided in Appendix A.5.2 .
paragraphs.zh: EviRover 使用一套包含十种工具的系统，这些工具用于轨迹标注、训练和评估。 四种工具用于获取外部证据：文本搜索、文本转图像搜索、图像搜索和网络浏览。 三种工具支持精细的视觉检查，例如裁剪某个区域以便更近距离地观察，以及在原始图像上渲染候选区域以进行验证。 其余三种工具支持特定任务的预测：基于 SAM3 的掩码生成、用于“找不同”查询的区域并排比较，以及一个 Python 解释器。 表 6 总结了可用的工具；详细规格和完整的工具方案见附录 A.5.2。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate primarily on EviLens, and additionally on WebEyes, a search-based grounding, segmentation and VQA benchmark. All methods receive the same input prompt (Appendix A.5.1 ) and use the same task-specific output interfaces, with coordinates normalized to [ 0 , 1000 ] [0,1000] and boxes in xyxy format. Direct baselines predict a box from the image and query in a single pass; segmentation converts the predicted box into a mask with SAM3, and counting returns an integer. Agentic baselines and EviRover additionally have access to the tool framework of Section 3.3 , with a limit of 35 tool calls per trajectory. Further details are given in Appendix A.3 .

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 2 , EviLens is challenging for all model families. Among proprietary models, Gemini-3.5-Flash, Seed-2.1-Turbo, and GPT-5.6-Sol perform best overall. Gemini-3.5-Flash and Seed-2.1-Turbo lead on recognition and counting, and Seed-2.1-Turbo achieves the highest segmentation score of any model ( 0.779 0.779 gIoU). GPT-5.6-Sol performs notably poorly on spot-the-difference, achieving a micro-F1 of only 0.112, as it consistently predicts a single bounding box even when the prompt indicates multiple differences.

paragraphs.en: Open-source models perform substantially worse. Despite strong results on conventional perception benchmarks, segmentation specialists reach at most 0.343 gIoU, and grounding specialists achieve near-zero IoU on localization. General-purpose open-source MLLMs exhibit similarly limited performance. The difficulty of EviLens therefore lies not in perceptual precision but in acquiring the evidence each query lacks, a capability that existing perception benchmarks do not evaluate.

paragraphs.en: To examine whether evidence-seeking training affects standard perception, we evaluate EviRover on grounding and segmentation in ReasonSeg and RefCOCOg (Table 4 ). EviRover improves over its backbone on every split and metric, and outperforms task-specific models on most metrics, such as Seg-Zero-7B on segmentation and Perception-R1 on grounding. paragraphs.en: In this work, we study perception under insufficient evidence, where a single glance at the image does not suffice to resolve the query. We reformulate perception in this setting as an evidence-seeking process. To support this formulation, we develop two dedicated data generation pipelines and construct EviLens, a human-verified benchmark for evaluating perception under insufficient evidence. Building on these data, we train EviRover to actively seek the missing evidence required by each query through supervised fine-tuning followed by agentic reinforcement learning. Experiments show that EviRover substantially improves over its backbone on EviLens and WebEyes, and that these gains extend to conventional perception and general multimodal benchmarks. These results suggest that perception can move beyond a single glance: learning to identify and acquire missing evidence improves perceptual accuracy and yields evidence-seeking capabilities that generalize to broader multimodal reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了证据不足情况下的感知问题，即仅凭对图像的一次观察不足以解决查询。 我们将这种情境下的感知重新定义为一种寻找证据的过程。 为了支持这一表述，我们开发了两条专门的数据生成流程，并构建了 EviLens——一个经过人类验证的基准，用于评估证据不足情况下的感知能力。 基于这些数据，我们通过监督微调结合智能体强化学习的方式训练 EviRover，使其能够主动寻找每个查询所需的缺失证据。 实验表明，EviRover 在 EviLens 和 WebEyes 上的表现显著优于其基础模型，且这些改进也延伸到了传统的感知任务和通用的多模态基准测试中。 这些结果表明，感知能力可以超越单次观察：学习识别并获取缺失证据能够提升感知准确性，并产生可推广至更广泛多模态推理的寻找证据的能力。

paragraphs.en: Beyond correctness, we also filter SFT trajectories by their behavior patterns. Trajectories in which the annotation model answers directly, or verifies its answer with only a single tool call, typically reflect knowledge that the annotation model already possesses. Since Qwen3VL-4B-Instruct may lack this knowledge, imitating such trajectories would teach it to answer without supporting evidence, encouraging hallucination. We therefore downsample these trajectories, retaining a portion so that the model still learns to answer directly when its own knowledge suffices.
paragraphs.zh: 除了正确性之外，我们还根据行为模式对 SFT 轨迹进行筛选。 在那些标注模型直接作答，或仅通过一次工具调用验证其答案的轨迹中，通常反映了标注模型已经掌握的知识。 由于 Qwen3VL-4B-Instruct 可能缺乏这些知识，模仿此类轨迹会教会它不提供支持证据就直接作答，从而助长幻觉。 因此，我们对这些轨迹进行下采样，同时保留一部分，以确保模型在自身知识足够时仍能学会直接作答。

paragraphs.en: The segmentation reward requires SAM3 to return a mask for the predicted box and point prompts. When SAM3 fails to produce a mask, we do not assign zero reward. Under group-relative advantage estimation, a zero reward is not a neutral outcome: it enters the group mean and shifts the advantages of every other rollout for the same prompt, so a tool failure unrelated to prediction quality would corrupt the learning signal for the rest of the group. We instead treat the predicted box as a rectangular mask and compute the IoU against the ground truth, which preserves the ordering of rollouts by localization quality while remaining a strict lower bound on what SAM3 would have returned. Trajectories scored this way are flagged in the training metadata so that the fallback rate can be monitored.
paragraphs.zh: 分割奖励要求 SAM3 返回一个针对预测框和点提示的掩码。 当 SAM3 未能生成掩码时，我们不会分配零奖励。 在组相对优势估计中，零奖励并非中性结果：它会进入组均值，并改变同一提示下所有其他展开的优势，因此与预测质量无关的工具故障会破坏该组其余部分的训练信号。 我们转而将预测框视为一个矩形掩码，并与真实值计算交联比（IoU），这既能保持按定位质量对展开的排序，同时仍然是 SAM3 可能返回结果的严格下界。 以这种方式评分的轨迹会在训练元数据中被标记，以便可以监控回退率。

The remaining boxes are matched to the annotated differences by greedy one-to-one assignment: candidate pairs with IoU at least 0.5 0.5 are sorted by IoU in descending order, and each pair is accepted if neither its predicted box nor its annotated region has already been matched. sents.en: All three may be called repeatedly within a trajectory.
sents.zh: 在这三个操作中，所有三种都可以在一条轨迹中被重复调用。

paragraphs.en: verify_mask runs SAM3 locally on the proposed box together with any point prompts and returns the resulting mask as an overlay, so that the agent can inspect and revise its prompts before committing to a final answer. compare_lr applies only to spot-the-difference queries: given a box in the left panel, it returns the corresponding regions of both panels side by side, separated by a colored divider. Boxes must lie within the left panel. The python tool is provided with the original image and all tool-returned images as preloaded variables, along with numpy , PIL , cv2 , scipy , math , json , and copy . It returns an image only when the executed code produces one.
paragraphs.zh: verify_mask 会在提议的框上本地运行 SAM3，并结合任何点提示，返回生成的掩码作为叠加层，以便智能体在提交最终答案前能够检查并修改其提示。compare_lr 仅适用于找不同问题：给定左侧面板中的一个框，它会返回两个面板中对应区域的并排显示结果，两者之间由彩色分隔线隔开。 框必须位于左侧面板内。 Python 工具会获得原始图像以及所有工具返回的图像作为预加载变量，同时还会获得 numpy、PIL、cv2、scipy、math、json 和 copy。 只有当执行后的代码生成图像时，它才会返回图像。
